en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Abdullah bin Ja’far al-Himyari, that he said: We were told by Ibrahim bin Hashim, from Muhammed bin Abi ‘Umayr, from Muthanna, the wheat seller, from Ja’far bin Muhammed, from his father, peace be upon them both, that he said:
The Days of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, are three: The Day in which the Riser will rise, the Day of Return and the Day of Resurrection.
